text:
alex: Heads up — I'm starting a short sync to align runtime + infra on the new metrics + dashboards for routing policies, quotas, and rollout UX. Need label proposals, cardinality caps, and which metrics are safe to surface in the Console.

tara: +1. Can we list the concrete dashboards we want first? e.g., routing policy heatmap, per-route quota usage, fallback events.

alex: Yes. Initial scope: 1) routing policy performance (latency, error rate) by policy type, 2) quota consumption by customer and route, 3) rollout success (canary vs baseline) and traffic split traces.

jun: For labels — we should avoid freeform route names as labels. Use `route_id` (stable low-cardinality) + `route_name` in a metadata service only. High-cardinality knobs: customer_id, user_id — careful.

maria: Agreed. Also need `model_variant` (e.g., gptx-8k-q4) but limit to enumerated values. Don't emit optimizer-specific strings or git SHAs as labels.

sam: For routing policy, proposed label set: `service`, `route_id`, `region`, `routing_policy`, `model_variant`, `deployment_tier`. Keep `routing_policy` enum as: `latency_priority`, `cost_priority`, `fallback`, `regional_preference`.

ryan: Quick thought on quotas: per-tenant quota panels require `tenant_id` — that's high-cardinality. For Console we can show top N tenants + a “rest” bucket. Prom should still export `tenant_id` for internal use, but dashboards must aggregate.

alex: Good pattern: export raw labels to Prom/OTel but provide recommended dashboard queries that group/aggregate to bound cardinality. We should document the recommended group_by fields per dashboard.

devops-bot: Deploy notice: prometheus-exporter-v2 rolled at 10:12. No metric schema changes in this deploy.

maria: On naming conventions — propose prefix `redwood_inference_` for Prom metrics and use OTel spans/resources mirror. Example latency histo: `redwood_inference_request_latency_seconds` + standard `_bucket/_sum/_count`. Error rate: `redwood_inference_request_errors_total` with `error_type` label.

jun: +1. Also recommend metric -> semantic mapping doc: which metrics are SLO candidates, which are internal. Put it in this repo and reference in Console config.

sam: Cardinality rules proposal (short): 1) any label that can exceed ~200 values must be gated and aggregated in dashboards; 2) freeform strings banned as labels; 3) numeric ids OK if used sparingly and aggregated. Thoughts?

tara: That feels reasonable. We should add a hard cap for direct Grafana queries used by Console (e.g., `max_label_values=500`) and instrument dashboards with a warning if a query would exceed it.

alex: Action items: (1) runtime team to publish draft label whitelist + example metrics (jun), (2) infra to add aggregation helpers & dashboard templates (tara + ryan), (3) devex to write Console binding guide with examples (maria). Can we aim for a draft by EOD Friday?

jun: I'll put a PR with the label whitelist and sample `prometheus.yml` relabel rules by Thursday. Will include examples: ```
# example relabel to drop high-cardinality label
- source_labels: [__meta_k8s_label_user]
  action: replace
  target_label: user_hash
  regex: (.+)
  replacement: "$1"
  # then use `user_hash` sparingly in dashboards
```

ryan: Infra will add a `dashboard-slices` templating module. Will include aggregation snippets like `topk(20, sum by (route_id) (redwood_inference_tokens_total))`.

maria: I'll draft Console docs showing how to bind a route slice to panels and how to fallback to aggregated views. Also include guidance on exposing `routing_policy` in rollout UX.

sam: One API debate we need to settle: should runtime expose `policy_decision` as a count metric for each request (labelled by reason) or as an event/log only? Count metric helps dashboards but could explode.

alex: Prefer a count metric with `policy_decision` limited to small enum and `decision_reason` only in logs. That keeps dashboards actionable without creating new high-cardinality labels.

tara: +1. Also let's ensure OTel resource attributes include `deployment_tier` and `team_owner` so traces filter cleanly.

jun: Note: converting OTel attributes -> Prom labels will be done at the exporter. I'll add relabel rules to map `service.name` -> `service` and `redwood.route.id` -> `route_id`.

devops-bot: Reminder: metrics schema review meeting scheduled Thu 15:00 in #eng-platform. Calendar invite sent.

alex: Perfect. If anyone has a stark objection to the label list above speak now otherwise I'll mark the action items and we iterate in the meeting. :thumbsup:

sam: No objection from runtime side. I'll review jun's PR when up.

maria: No objections. Will start doc skeleton.

ryan: LGTM — infra will prototype dashboard module.

tara: OK. Thanks all — see you Thu.
